en: Dependent on an indeterminate state that is acquired and subject to clinging, an unwholesome state that is neither-acquired-nor-subject-to-clinging arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is acquired and subject to clinging, a non-unwholesome state that is neither-acquired-nor-subject-to-clinging arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on an indeterminate state that is acquired and subject to clinging, an unwholesome [state]...
States that are neither-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging and neither-unwholesome-nor-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
There are three [answers] for root; three for conascence … pe … three for non-disappearance.
A wholesome state that is not-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a wholesome state that is not-not-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging.

Conditioned relation. A wholesome state that is not clung-to but is subject to clinging is related to a state that is neither unwholesome nor not clung-to but is subject to clinging by way of object-condition (*ārammaṇapaccaya*).

A wholesome state that is not clung-to but is subject to clinging is related to both a state that is neither wholesome nor not clung-to but is subject to clinging and a state that is neither unwholesome nor not clung-to but is subject to clinging by way of object-condition. ... [Three] sets.

In the unwholesome, three. In the indeterminate, which is neither-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging, three only … pe … In the object condition, nine; in the proximity condition, eleven … pe … in the decisive-support condition, fifteen; in the prenascence and repetition conditions, three; in the kamma condition, six; in the nutriment condition, three … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, three.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is neither-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging, an unwholesome state that is neither-clung-to-nor-object-of-clinging arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither-clung-to-nor-liable-to-clinging, an unwholesome state that is neither-clung-to-nor-liable-to-clinging arises by way of root condition... [three] (abbreviated). Under root condition there are six;
under predominance condition there are six... pe ... under result condition there are three... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are six.
